page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; three parallel columns of an alphabetical index of personal names; a letter-heading "I." and "K." set within the columns; catchword "Kagin-" at lower right below the last column.

page.notes: The index is set in three columns; the "I." and "K." are letter headings within the columns. Some entries are set in the scan with mixed legibility, especially at the right edge of the middle column; the rendering of the column contents follows the printed order, with the lines of the third column partly joined by the printed rules. Catchword "Kagin-" is at lower right.
